overlay.basis: Read by a person from aagento-bridge road-under-bridge-railway-rule-engine.ts (the registered railway road-under-bridge engine). The box geometry is the same rule engine shape as the RCC box families: every geometry value is added to levels in metres (z_bot = structTopBotSlab - tSB, bed level the finished floor), so parameters and outputs are metres unless noted. The BOQ (bill of quantities) fallback block returns fixed widths and heights in metres for standard sub-components (shear key, retaining walls, curtain walls, aprons, approach slab, crash barrier, expansion joint, ballast retainer): these are constants the engine returns, not read from the model, so they have no parameter of their own — only outputs.
